'''Virtual Block 7''' (Darkness Rising / Ultimate series) is a Players Committee '''legacy''' virtual expansion. These cards are no longer valid for competitive play; use the Decipher sets and the current virtual sets (2014 Reset onward).

The first subset, Virtual Set 7.1 Ultimate Power, came out on 18 June 2010.<ref name="vb71pdf" /><ref name="vb71forum" /> The Polish fan site star-wars.pl reported it on 27 June 2010.<ref name="vb71">[https://star-wars.pl/News/12035,Premiera_Virtual_Block_7_1_Ultimate_Power.html Premiera Virtual Block 7.1: Ultimate Power], star-wars.pl (27 June 2010).</ref> Later subsets: 7.2 Ultimate Freedom (released '''13 December 2010''', tournament legal '''29 December 2010'''), 7.3 Ultimate Conflict (3 June 2011) and 7.4 Ultimate Legacy (16 December 2011).

The combined legacy list is also published as Virtual Master on the Players Committee cardlists.


Some of these cards were later reused in the current virtual sets (2014 Reset onward), usually with updated frames and set icons.
